phrases.english_concept: the dominant Romanian habit of typing online without diacritics (ă â î ș ț) — and its consequence for what every search query actually looks like
phrases.register: describes informal/default online register; the debate about it is itself informal-to-heated
phrases.content_surface: faq, body, tool copy — and as a silent rule governing every other ro phrase's searched form
phrases.usage_guidance: Treat this as a standing rule for ro/ pages rather than a phrase to insert: (a) never assume a Romanian query arrives with diacritics, (b) write ro/ page copy WITH correct diacritics (that is the published-content register, and our own ro/ pages already do), but (c) make sure the page can be found by, and reads naturally to, someone whose own input has none. A one-line FAQ acknowledging that styled output works whether or not you type ă/â/î/ș/ț is well-matched to real user doubt. ro/fonturi-pentru-instagram/ already gestures at this ('Pentru bio-uri și nume fără diacritice arată perfect') — that instinct is correct and could be generalised.
phrases.good_example: Funcționează și dacă scrii fără diacritice — poți stiliza atât „Ștefan” cât și „Stefan”.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not turn this into a moralising note. The diacritics question is a live, sometimes hostile identity argument in Romanian online culture ('Dacă nu scrieţi cu diacritice, limba română dispare!' vs. 'De ce au unii o obsesie cu diacriticele?'). A font-generator page has no standing in that fight and should not take a side; mention it only as a practical compatibility fact.
